text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A flawless race brought to perfection as 
everyone gave their absolute all. Mejiro 
Ramonu dedicates her love and victory to 
it.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Reminded that she, too, wanted to keep 
loving the sport of racing, Symboli Rudolf 
declared her return to the track.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Ramonu's racing is never over. She 
will seek the ultimate race, and continue 
to love it. Until her very body burns out.
